metadata.title: Taal
Language
Langue
metadata.difficultyPolicy: Every subcategory/grade has a mixed distribution of difficulty stars: 34 one-star, 33 two-star, 33 three-star exercises per 100.
metadata.answerPolicy: Every answer option display value and value must be unique inside the exercise. Shape answers must use symbols, not shape names.
metadata.generatedPuzzlePolicy: Do not include sudoku or math_crossword here; those are generated in-app.
metadata.answerDisplayLocalizationPolicy: Answer options now include <display locale="nl-BE|en-US|fr-BE">. Use canonical answer/@value for correctness and locale display for UI.
